metadata.title: MDI3003 Lab 07 Dataset Manifest
metadata.guardrail: RESPONSIBLE RECOMMENDATION GUARDRAIL: Recommendation is a prediction of likely relevance, not proof of preference or intent. This system must not be used for discriminatory pricing, protected-class targeting, credit decisions, or manipulative personalization. Do not expose identifiable purchase histories in screenshots or shared reports. Assess popularity bias, concentration, and unfair exclusion of less-active customers or niche items.

D1.return_cancellation_policy: Explicitly removed InvoiceNo starting with 'C'; never treated as positive relevance
D1.missing_id_policy: Explicitly dropped unauthenticated sessions (missing CustomerID) with count audited
D1.privacy_usage_note: Public research dataset; no direct PII; customer IDs treated as non-ordinal join keys

D2.return_cancellation_policy: Implicit events (views, add-to-cart, transactions); views serve as implicit interaction signal
D2.missing_id_policy: All rows contain visitorid; dropped any nulls if present
D2.privacy_usage_note: Anonymized visitor IDs and item IDs; CC0 Public Domain

D3.return_cancellation_policy: Completed grocery orders; reorder binary flag indicates repeat purchase
D3.missing_id_policy: User IDs fully mapped through orders metadata table
D3.privacy_usage_note: Anonymized grocery orders published by Instacart for research competitions

D4.return_cancellation_policy: Explicitly removed InvoiceNo starting with 'C'; never treated as positive relevance
D4.missing_id_policy: Explicitly dropped missing CustomerID records with count logged
D4.privacy_usage_note: Public 2-year transaction benchmark; no direct PII; identifiers treated as non-ordinal keys
